prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too optimistic across all tests compared to measured outcomes.
Evidence remains thin for all specific change types (sign_in reorder, home redesign, finish layout, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, home notification) as each has only been tested once.
No kinds of change have been proven helpful yet, as no tests have won.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Pet Carousel View: Redesign the pet selection screen into a carousel layout with playful animation cards to make choosing a pet more engaging. (why: Adoption step has a 60.9% conversion rate and long completion times (median 89s / mean 1017s), showing users hesitate during pet selection.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Habitat Preview Screen: Introduce a pre-choice pet habitat preview screen showcasing desktop pet interactions before selecting an adoption path. (why: Choose path dropoff (76.2% conversion, mean 514s) and post-onboarding support confusion indicate users need early context.)
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Progress Dashboard: Transform the waiting screen into a checklist progress dashboard showing pet creation steps with estimated time remaining. (why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) and conversion drops to 81.3%, leading users to suspect the app stalled.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Companion Celebration Screen: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing the pet's arrival celebration and clear onboarding completion CTA. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with median time 395s, indicating user drop-off right before completing setup.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Persistence Hint: Display a clear persistence tip below the sign-in options explaining that signing in prevents pet loss across desktop sessions. (why: Support mail logged 8 complaints of lost or reset pets after re-authenticating.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Tip Carousel: Add a rotating tip carousel component on the waiting screen explaining background pet processing. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s) and leads to user friction or app abandonment.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Value Proposition Copy: Update the headline and body of the choose_path screen to highlight instant pet adoption versus custom pet creation. (why: Choose path conversion is 76.2% with long mean time (514s), showing users need clearer expectations before choosing.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Visual Scroll Storytelling: Update the story screen layout to story_scroll to present the intro narrative as a smooth visual scroll before path selection. (why: Median story/choose_path time has a high mean (514s), suggesting users stall on the initial static story presentation.)

scores.note: Targets the highest dropoff step (60.9% adoption rate), but redesigns carry high risk of neutral or negative lift.
Adding a new screen increases friction despite addressing user confusion noted in support context.
Addresses long wait time, but home redesigns previously produced 0.0% lift at high implementation cost.
Targets low finish conversion (64.8%), but past finish layout changes resulted in -2.5% lift.
Strongly supported by 8 support emails and funnel dropoff; low-friction text hint with high feasibility.
Minor info component targeting high wait times; aligns with slightly positive home notification test (+0.6%).
Choose path copy changes achieved the best historical result (+1.2%) and require zero UI redesign.
Layout revamp carries execution risk and cost without proven success in prior layout tests.
